protocol: byte-identical to E228 e226_auc2W: task-wise z-score on fit rows -> sqrt(w_b) block weights (per fold: auc_lofo^2 mean over the other 19 folds, normalised to mean 1; deploy model: frozen E227 weights) -> subtract fit mean pm, multiply PCA W -> k=12 k-means prototypes per (task, identity). Nothing is refitted for the Test read-out; the frozen E227 deploy model is used.

scoring_variants.abs: score = -d1, d1 = distance to the nearest same-task prototype (E228 reference)
scoring_variants.margin: score = d2 - d1, d2 = distance to the nearest prototype of a DIFFERENT identity in the same task. Translation of both distances by a common offset cancels in the difference.
scoring_variants.ratio: score = -d1 / d2 (negated so that high = known); invariant to a multiplicative rescaling of all distances
scoring_variants.mix: score = -d1 + lam * (d2 - d1), lam fixed in config; interpolates between abs (lam=0) and margin-dominated (lam>1)
scoring_variants.distance_rule: d1 and d2 are computed within the SAME task; d2 excludes every prototype whose identity equals the nearest prototype's identity. Euclidean distance in the frozen PCA96 space.
scoring_variants.why: score = -d1 is not invariant to an additive cross-session offset: a shift delta that increases every distance of a registered user lowers the score uniformly. A relative score removes the common part of the shift at the level of each row.

threshold.rule: tau = (1-A) quantile of the candidate's own inner 5-block OOF known scores (fit rows, all 20 identities); A is bisected on Train so that the pooled (micro) LOSO unknown rejection is the largest value still >= 0.90 (E228 rule, identical code path).
threshold.note: Every candidate gets its own A and tau because the score scale changes with the metric; the calibration uses Train rows only. Test is read once per candidate after the freeze.

limitations: Official Test C / RA / ASafeR are N/A: Test has no identity labels. The session-level S1 rejection >= 0.95 is a reviewer-imposed proxy, not an official metric. Test has been inspected repeatedly since E65, so every S2 number carries a repeated-inspection bias. Session and registration status are confounded (E232: S1 = 5 unregistered subjects, S2 = 20 registered users), so S1/S2 are behavioural proxies, not clean biometric metrics. The mean_align statistics are estimated from the unlabeled batch being scored (transductive grey zone).
